Bloodghast.mechanic: an effect returning a card from a graveyard to the battlefield under its owner's control (Effect has only ReturnToHand and ReturnTransformed); also a rule that a creature can't block (RuleChange governs only casting spells and loyalty abilities)
Bloodghast.text:
This creature can't block.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Flickerwisp.mechanic: a delayed ability that carries an object (the exiled card) and an effect returning a card from exile to the battlefield under its owner's control
Flickerwisp.text: When this creature enters, exile another target permanent. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
